brief:
Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called Wednesday for an immediate halt to his corruption trial, Middle East Eye reported. The demand followed remarks by judges that cast doubt on the charges against him.

The trial, which has extended over several years, centers on allegations Netanyahu faces. His call for cessation came in the wake of the judicial skepticism toward the prosecution's case.

title: Netanyahu demands judges end his corruption trial after expressing doubt
